name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) hard is the command to open the door, and it is lone because the only later step is soft. Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard is the 'then' order. The 'if possible' cue scopes only the box pickup, so Existence(target_picked_up) is soft.

texts: Open the door, so the door is open at some point.
Pick up the box in the other room only after the door has been opened; the 'then' order is required.
If possible, pick up the box in the other room (preferred, not required).
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up, u1) -> -100.694
